3 شَارَكْتُ فُلَانًا , (S, TA,) inf. n. مُشَارَكَةٌ, (TK,) [I shared, participated, or partook, with such a one;] I was, or became, the شَرِيك [or copartner &c.] of such a one. (S, TA.) El-Jaadee says, “وَشَارَكْنَا قُرَيْشًا فِى تُقَاهَا
العِنَانِ ↓ وَفِى أَحْسَابِهَا شِرْكَ
” [And we shared with Kureysh in their piety and in their several grounds of pretension to respect, with a sharing exclusive of other properties]. (S.) See also 1. [And see 8.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
